title: rubus contiguus
intro: Rubus contiguus, commonly known as Thimbleberry, is a type of deciduous shrub native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Thimbleberry include acting as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rubus contiguus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
